extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: 1960s microbus, approx. 4.5 x 2.1 x 2.0 m (L x W x H incl. mirrors), wheel diameter 0.66 m
extras.notes: front faces -Y; generic, brand-free 1960s forward-control microbus: two-tone paint (teal lower body, cream upper body with straight chrome divider), split windshield, round headlights, slim chrome grille band, rear vents, chrome bumpers; 4 wheels are separate objects with origin on the hub (rotate around local X to roll); hollow interior with three bench seats and steering wheel; no front emblem, no brand, no logo, no text, blank number plates

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
